artworks.title: Portrait of a Family
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a family portrait featuring four people from the waist up. The man and woman are seated with a child on each of their laps. The man, positioned on the left of the image, has a short mustache and neatly combed dark hair, wearing a dark suit with a white shirt underneath. The woman, on the right, has her hair styled up and is dressed in a patterned, dark dress with a high collar and buttons running down the front. The two children are wearing white, lace-detailed gowns; the child on the left has lighter hair and rests on the man's knee, while the child on the right, with slightly longer hair, is on the woman's knee. The background consists of a plain gray surface. There is a visible red cloth in the lower left and right corners of the image.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Family
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a family portrait featuring a man, a woman, and a child, whose bodies are shown from the waist up. The woman, seated on the left, holds the child on her lap. She has long, dark hair parted in the center and cascading in loose waves, and her expression is neutral. She is dressed in a dark outfit with long sleeves. The child is wearing a bright blue dress with puffed sleeves and is seated with a relaxed posture. The man, seated on the right, has a dark beard and mustache, with neatly combed hair styled upward and a serious expression. He wears a formal dark suit with a white shirt underneath, and his arm rests on his lap. The backdrop is a simple and neutral dark brown.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man and a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, a man and a woman, both visible from the waist up and seated. The man is positioned on the left with his right arm bent and resting on an unseen surface, while his left hand holds the lapel of his jacket. He has short hair and a beard, along with a serious expression. His attire consists of a dark jacket over a vest and a white shirt with a bow tie. The woman is seated to his right with both arms bent and her right hand resting in her lap. She has her hair pulled back and gazes directly at the viewer with a neutral expression. She is dressed in a patterned, dark garment with a high, white collar, and a brooch at the neck, with a belt at her waist. The background is dark and plain.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the waist up. He is seated in a dignified position with both hands visible. He has a solemn expression on his face, with distinct facial features including a thick mustache and short wavy hair parted to one side. He is wearing dark-colored formal attire, consisting of a suit jacket, waistcoat, and a white shirt with a bow tie. The man is sitting on a piece of red-patterned upholstery that contrasts with his outfit. The background is plain and dark, with some areas of wear and tear visible.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man and a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man and a woman, focusing on their upper bodies and faces. The woman has short, dark hair and is wearing a dark green dress. The man has a mustache and is wearing a black suit with a white shirt and a bowtie, along with a hat on his head. The background is plain with a dark, muted tone.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: This image shows a portrait of a woman from the upper half of her body. She is facing the viewer directly with a neutral expression. Her features include a serious demeanor, light complexion, and dark hair styled back smoothly and pinned or held in place. She is wearing a button-up garment with long sleeves, a high lace-trimmed collar, and a large dark ribbon tied in a bow at her throat. The background is a solid green color.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image is an oval-framed portrait of a woman's upper body and head. She is facing forward with a neutral expression. Her facial features include a slight frown, thin eyebrows, and tightly pursed lips. Her dark hair is neatly pulled back and she wears a dark dress with a high collar and white trim. The woman also wears earrings and a brooch at her collar. The background is a muted blue color. The frame around the image is ornate and golden, carved with floral and leaf patterns.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man and Woman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man and a woman positioned side by side. The man is on the left and is facing forward with a serious expression. He has short, dark hair styled to the side and a mustache. He is dressed in a formal suit with a white shirt and a patterned bow tie. The woman, positioned on the right, also faces directly towards the viewer with a neutral expression. Her dark hair is parted in the middle and smooth, reaching just below her ears. She wears a dark dress with a high neckline and a small decorative pin at the collar. Both individuals are positioned against a neutral backdrop without any visible objects or furniture, set within a decorated wooden frame with detailed gold embellishments and floral details on the matte.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man and Woman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image features a portrait of a man and a woman, depicting their upper bodies. The man is on the left, seated upright with a calm expression, short dark hair, and a mustache. He is wearing a dark buttoned jacket with a high collar, decorative buttons, and a wide-brimmed dark hat. The woman is seated on the right, also upright, with her hands folded on her lap. She has dark hair pulled back neatly, wearing a dress with a white collar, long sleeves, and accessories. The backdrop is plain and dark, with slightly worn edges on the photograph.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person with just the upper body and head visible. The individual is facing forward with a composed expression. They have dark hair styled in a way that frames their face, with sections that appear to be braided. The person wears a dress with a checkered pattern in dark and light shades, featuring a high collar. Around their neck is a black necklace with a gold-colored circular pendant. They are also wearing earrings. The background is a textured dark blue.

artworks.title: "Tarpon or Silver King"
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image depicts two men standing on a boat. The man on the left is holding up a large fish, wearing a light-colored shirt with long sleeves, dark pants, and gloves. The man on the right has his arms crossed, facing the fish, and is dressed in dark clothing with a straw boater hat. Both men have facial features visible, and there are various ropes and fishing gear on the boat. The background shows a simple horizon line, suggesting an open water scene. The image is in a vintage blue tint.

artworks.title: Railroad Workers and Machine
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a steam-powered machine or engine on a railway track. It is positioned on wooden rails or beams, likely associated with railway operations. The setting is industrial, with additional equipment and ropes nearby. Steam is rising from the chimney, indicating recent activity. The environment appears open, possibly sparsely vegetated. The photograph has a monochromatic tone with a blue tint.

artworks.title: Glacier Point and South Dome, Yosemite Valley, California
artworks.artist: William Henry Jackson, Detroit Photographic Company
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: This print shows a canyon with rocky terrain, seen from a high vantage point. The horizon shows more mountains fading into the distance under a blue sky with light clouds. On the right, a group of people stand on the top of a tall, dark cliff near the upper right corner. They appear to be dressed in black, with gray skin and no visible facial features. The rocks below them are in shadow, while the ones in the distance are brightly lit, in shades of pale gray and blue and dotted with green plant life.

artworks.title: Quarry
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a landscape with large, angular stone blocks. The stones are scattered, creating a rugged texture. The horizon is high in the image, meeting a cloudy sky with poles connected by cables. A central pole stands out and the cables extend outward. The color palette is dominated by cyan tones, creating a monochromatic and cool effect. The composition includes cables and stones in a minimalistic aesthetic.

artworks.title: Title from caption on object: "Read All About It!"
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon

artworks.title: Henry Ford
artworks.medium: gelatin silver print with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a suit, standing upright with his arms crossed. He has a long, narrow face with deep-set eyes, a slight smile, and neatly combed light-colored hair. The man is wearing a dark jacket, a shirt, and a patterned tie, with a boutonnière on the lapel. The oval frame around his head has markings and scribbles, including sketches or annotations. The background is a plain gradient, darker at the top and lighter at the bottom.

artworks.title: Au Théâtre Antoine
artworks.medium: brush and black ink over graphite on brown paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jeffrey Atlas in memory of his mother Liane Atlas
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures in a close space, depicted with bold brushstrokes in sepia tones. The background is loosely sketched, suggesting an interior setting. The figures are grouped together, some with more detail than others, creating a sense of depth and movement. In the lower right, there are abstract elements. The style is expressionistic, capturing the essence of the scene through minimalist elements.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an indoor scene with various figures interacting together. The artwork depicts a gathering of figures, some holding each other and others engaged in presenting objects to one another. The composition includes a seated figure cradling an infant on their lap. To the right, a kneeling figure presents a basket containing what appear to be fruits or food. In the background, there is a makeshift structure composed of wood planks and various building elements. The use of line work suggests intricate texturing, particularly in the drapery and architectural details throughout the drawing. The arrangement of figures and the detailed cross hatching hints at a narrative central to the scene.

artworks.title: Homage to Psyche
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Nicolo Vicentino, after Francesco Salviati
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from three blocks in brown and ochre on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural setting with classical figures. The composition depicts a gathering of figures in ancient attire, surrounded by classical architecture. The central figures appear engaged in a ritual or ceremonial act, indicated by their poses and the presence of urns and smoke rising from vessels on the ground. In the background, there are significant architectural structures, including columns and a domed building reminiscent of classical antiquity. The use of contrasting dark and light tones highlights the forms and gestures of the figures, creating a dynamic interaction in the scene.

artworks.title: Young Girl Reading
artworks.medium: red and black chalk on buff laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jeffrey E. Horvitz
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the waist up, sitting in a relaxed position with her body angled slightly forward. She is reading a book held with both hands, facing down in profile. She has light hair tucked under a white bonnet and wears a light-colored, loose-fitting dress with long sleeves. A cloth is draped beside her on the surface. The background has a simple shading.

artworks.title: Standing Boy in a Landscape
artworks.medium: red chalk on buff laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of  Ann Sutherland Harris
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body view of a young boy from behind, standing with a stick in his left hand. The boy's head is slightly turned to the left. He has short, textured hair and is wearing a loose top, baggy trousers, and knee-length boots. There is overgrown foliage on his right and a body of water or similar surface nearby. In the background, there is an architectural structure and lawn.

artworks.title: The Penitent Magdalene
artworks.medium: black chalk with brown wash and watercolor on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of  Ann Sutherland Harris
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on a rock. The individual is in a side profile, facing left, with their head slightly bowed and one hand resting on their chest. They have soft and contemplative facial features, long hair flowing over their shoulders. The person is clothed in a flowing garment and holds an object in their other hand. The background consists of trees and foliage around the figure.

artworks.title: The Angel Appearing to Hagar and Ishmael in the Wilderness
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of  Ann Sutherland Harris
artworks.description: This drawing depicts two winged figures flying through dynamic clouds in the sky. Below, there is a seated figure looking up attentively and another figure either lying down or emerging from the ground. The background features swirling forms, creating a sense of movement. The composition uses loose, flowing lines and neutral tones, giving it a timeless quality. The drawing evokes an ethereal, mythological atmosphere with its expressive and fluid style.

artworks.title: Saint Francis Receiving the Stigmata
artworks.creditLine: Gift of  Ann Sutherland Harris
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a kneeling position, with his hands clasped together in front of him. He has a beard and short hair, and is dressed in a long robe. The background shows clouds, trees, and a sun. The composition is rendered in reddish-brown tones.
